maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from regulated electricity generation, transmission and distribution billed to customers, not repair or replacement of customer-owned items.

publicly_funded.reason: PNM and TNMP bill households, businesses and retail electric providers; a regulated utility billing households counts as no.

serial_acquirer.reason: Growth comes from rate-based investment in regulated PNM and TNMP utilities, not a steady stream of acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Regulated electric utility supplying power to about 800,000 homes and businesses in New Mexico and Texas; customers cannot switch.
